# kemp_virtual_service (Resource)

Manages a LoadMaster virtual service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kemp_virtual_service" "web" {
  address  = "10.0.253.50"
  port     = "443"
  nickname = "web_https"
  type     = "http"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address the virtual service listens on.
- `port` (String) Port the virtual service listens on.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the virtual service is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `nickname` (String) Display name for the virtual service.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: tcp or udp. Changing this forces a new virtual service. Defaults to tcp.
- `type` (String) Service type: gen, http, http2, ts, tls or log. Defaults to gen.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The virtual service index, as a string.
- `index` (Number) LoadMaster-assigned virtual service index.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Virtual services are imported by their LoadMaster index.
terraform import kemp_virtual_service.web 3
```
